subject: The CEO meeting starts in 23 minutes
body:
Welcome aboard. I have twenty-three minutes and one question: what are the three cyber risks I should be most concerned about?

You have inherited 6,283 critical vulnerabilities, 17 high-priority audit findings, 23 open risk register entries, four transformation programmes, fourteen important suppliers and five security vacancies.

Where do you start?

subject: She remembered what you said you did not know
body: When you gave me your three risks in your first month, you told me which of them you were unsure about. I have had cause to repeat that to the board, and it has done you no harm at all. Tell me what you are unsure about now.

subject: External audit: privileged access, third year running
body:
The auditors have raised privileged access management again. That is three consecutive years, and the audit committee has noticed.

I need a response from you for the committee papers. Please do not send me the same remediation plan we sent last year.

subject: Next year's plan has gone to the board
body: Next year's plan has gone to the board with the cyber line as we agreed. I recorded the reasons you gave, in your words. If the year had been different, so would the conversation, and we both know it.

subject: The warehouse platform question
body:
I am told the Meridian platform is running on software that is no longer supported. I am also told it cannot be upgraded and that migration is at least a year away.

Despatch runs on it. Three sites. If it stops, we stop. What are you proposing to do about that?

subject: The fallback you paid for
body: The manual fulfilment fallback you funded was exercised last week, for four hours, during a planned change that did not go to plan. Nobody outside the warehouse noticed. I thought you should know that the money did something.

subject: Your first year review
body:
Your first year is nearly up. I will want to talk about what changed, what you chose not to do, and whether we are in better shape than we were.

Bring the honest version.

subject: Kestrel integration: network join scheduled
body:
Completion is confirmed. Integration have scheduled the network join for day one, as planned since February.

I understand you have views. I would rather hear them now than at the steering committee.

subject: The synergy number moves to next year
body: The Kestrel synergy number moves to next year. I have explained why to the board, in your words rather than mine. I will want the boundary decision on my desk in the first week of January.

subject: The Kestrel savings are in
body: The Kestrel savings are in this year's numbers, and thank you. Stefan has asked that the boundary rules be kept on file in case we ever need to put them back. I have agreed; it costs nothing.

subject: The restore came back in three and a half
body: Four hours of payments was more than I wanted to give you. The restore came back in three and a half, the runbook held, and I have said so to Marianne. Next time you ask for a window I will find it faster.

subject: The restore ran past the window
body: Four hours of payments, and the restore ran past them. We got payments back, but not by the runbook: steps were out of date and one depended on an account that no longer exists. I would rather have found that in a window we chose than in one somebody else chose for us, and I have said so to Marianne.

subject: Cloud migration slips again
body:
The migration has slipped another quarter. The remaining legacy workloads are harder than the survey suggested and we have lost two engineers to the platform team.

I know what this does to your legacy exposure. I do not have a better answer today.

subject: The CIO wants the security conditions eased
body: Two delivery teams have raised that security review is now the longest step in their release process. I am not asking you to drop it. I am asking whether it has to look like this.

subject: The incident response plan names someone who left
body: The plan names an incident commander who left in March. It has not been exercised in two years. If something happens tomorrow, we will be inventing the process while using it.

subject: A rule nobody in finance set up
body: A finance mailbox forwards anything with 'invoice' in the subject to an outside address. Nobody in finance set it up. We have removed it, and we cannot yet say how long it was there.

body: The committee has asked for a cyber risk appetite statement. I would like something we could actually test a decision against, rather than three paragraphs about being risk-aware.
